architecture_decisions: - `SafeImplementationEngine`, `CanonicalizingTextPatchEngine`, `source-context authority`, `exact acceptance coverage`, `disposable candidate validation`, `independent evaluation`, `canonical lineage acceptance`, `Git/deployment authority`, and `human REVIEW ceiling remain authoritative and unchanged`.
work_items: - `Luna hit the server-owned 60-second model timeout`, `Terra returned a parsed proposal rejected by the server-owned safe proposal validator`, and `Sol received the existing validator-guided repair constraint but its parsed proposal was also rejected`.
validations: - `AUTONOMOUS_IMPLEMENT_FAILED`, `Luna hit the server-owned 60-second model timeout`, `Terra returned a parsed proposal rejected by the server-owned safe proposal validator`, and `Sol received the existing validator-guided repair constraint but its parsed proposal was also rejected`.

AC-01: validate protected requirement — Regression evidence encodes the observed sequence of one provider failure followed by safe-validator rejection(s) without converting provider failure into validator failure.

AC-02: validate protected requirement — When distinct admitted agents are exhausted and a validator rejection exists, exactly one deterministic same-agent repair assignment is produced for the most recent validator-rejected admitted agent.
AC-03: validate protected requirement — If all failures are provider/rate-limit failures, no final validator repair assignment is produced.
AC-04: validate protected requirement — The final repair request receives `VALIDATOR_REPAIR_GUIDANCE` and no rejected model output or arbitrary validator exception text.
AC-05: validate protected requirement — A work unit cannot receive more than one final validator repair retry, including when that retry itself times out or returns another rejected proposal.
AC-06: validate protected requirement — The repair assignment grants no canonical source, lineage, Git, deployment, REVIEW, credential, network, or lifecycle-transition authority.

AC-07: validate protected requirement — If repair still fails, durable diagnostics expose only bounded failure kind, admitted identity/generation, repair-attempted state, and existing false mutation/authority claims.
AC-08: validate protected requirement — A candidate that passes before distinct-agent exhaustion follows the existing path without a final repair attempt.

AC-09: validate protected requirement — Focused candidate-recovery tests, full API regression, Bounded Autonomy, client checks, protected promotion evaluation, protected spec/plan validation, and required DSPy validation pass on the exact PR head.

AC-10: validate protected requirement — After exact-source deployment, `/health` and `/ready` return HTTP 200 and the affected production run or an equivalent bounded workload proves that a final validator-rejected candidate no longer fails solely because the distinct-agent set was exhausted before one bounded repair retry.

critique: The production retry of Engineering Run `3a1ba66a-5649-42b6-81ee-91684fe06bbc` on P2-V0.23.22 no longer timed out at the HTTP layer. Instead, IMPLEMENT exhausted the admitted candidate set: Luna hit the server-owned 60-second model timeout, Terra returned a parsed proposal rejected by the server-owned safe proposal validator, and Sol received the existing validator-guided repair constraint but its parsed proposal was also rejected. The request returned HTTP 200 and the durable run failed safely with `AUTONOMOUS_IMPLEMENT_FAILED`; no canonical source mutation, lineage acceptance, Git mutation, deployment mutation, or REVIEW completion occurred.
